system.description:
Through a perfect combination of Mask of a Thousand Faces and Entrancement, the Setite can appear to another person as whoever she most dearly loves. The Setite can choose to impersonate someone she knows the victim loves, or let the victim's own mind define the 'true love' and let the power do the rest.

See Mask of a Thousand Faces for the base mechanic; the player must always expend a Mental Trait to use this power because the character always impersonates a specific person. This power costs nine Experience Traits to learn.
system.source: Clanbook: Followers of Set, Chapter Two
system.duration: As long as the vampire remains in the victim's presence
system.prerequisites: Obfuscate (Mask of a Thousand Faces), Presence (Entrancement)
